note: Small provincial campground 11 km west of Nordegg on Hwy 11, a stop-over for David Thompson Country, with open and treed sites for tents and RVs and a cook shelter. No water pump; bring drinking water. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated May 29, 2026): 14 unserviced sites at C$24, first come first served, dry toilets, cook shelter, no water pump. Season approximate May-Oct -> May 8 - Oct 4. PHONE missing: 1-855-721-3975 (Westward Bound). Not waterfront confirmed.

SEASON: derived 'About May to October' replaced by the page's 'Season: May 8 - Oct 4'. No shop listing (first come, first served), so no 2027 'Closed through' date.
SENIORS LINE: PRESENT ('This campground qualifies for the camping fee discount for Alberta seniors.'). No '90 days' line (FCFS only).
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed; a small, mostly dry gravel creek bed winds ~60-100 m east of the campground road through forest; Hwy 11 is ~80 m north.
PIN (52.42866,-116.20678): on the campground road ~150 m in from Hwy 11, matching the page's directions point (52.428658,-116.206775). No move.
